notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE - THE 4 WORLDS UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hello there, guys. New update for GO AWAY, THERE'S KUMIS OVER THERE! has just been released.

What's new:

- !!! NEW SOUNDTRACK by "H311" that named "Miami Horse"
- Choose between 4 different worlds, play anywhere you want! (The Green World, The Pink World, The Halloween World and the common world of Kumis)
- Piece of watermelon instead of cookie (some summer vibes ;))

I hope you guys will enjoy it! 

Best regards,

Besedka Games Studio
